capabilities: Sync Cubox cards into vault notes
Filter synced items by folder, tag, type, and status
Customize file names, front matter, and note body with templates
Run sync manually or on an automatic schedule
disambiguation: One-way and create-only: it never updates already-synced notes and never sends vault edits back to Cubox.
extras: Sync is create-only with id-based dedup; new highlights added in Cubox after a note is synced will not appear unless the user deletes the note and re-syncs. Sync stays blocked until all four filter categories have a selection.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull saved articles and annotations from the Cubox read-later service into notes.
summary: Official Cubox plugin that syncs saved articles and their highlights from Cubox into vault notes using filters, templates, and manual or scheduled sync.
